tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa dmigs rim dang bcas pa sogs yig cha nyer mkho 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zil dngar bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya tā rā sā dha naṃ/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// byang grol cha shas yongs gang 'phags ma'i zla ba ni// yid 'ong snying rje bdud rtsi'i snang ba dang 'grogs pas// sa gsum rgud cing phongs pa'i mun pa kun bsal te// srid zhi'i phun tshogs bsil ba rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /gang zhig chos ldan skyed tshal du// phan bde'i me tog 'bras 'bar ba'i// ring 'tsho'i dpag bsam rgyas pa'i slad// rig pa'i zil dngar bsten par gyis// de yang dad dang nges 'byung dang*// snying rjer ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos// thun mong min pa'i rjes gnang dang*// khrid rim zab mos rgyud smin pas// sngon dngos rjes kyis nyams blang ba'i// sngon 'gro'i dang po skyabs 'gro ni// snod bcud bde ba can lta bu'i// zhing khams yongs su dag pa'i gzhir// rang gi mdun du dpag bsam shing*// rab tu rgyas pa'i pad+ma'i dbus// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kun// 'od dpag med pa'i rnam par bzhugs// mdun du sgrol dkar sogs yi dam// g.yas su dus gsum rdzogs sangs rgyas// rgyab tu dam chos glegs bam tshul// g.yon du 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams// mngon sum lta bur gsal ba'i mdun// bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kun// 'jigs dang dad dang snying rje'i blos// sgo gsum gus pas skyabs 'gror dmigs// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar// bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum la// mi phyed gus pas skyabs su mchi// ci nus brjod pas skyabs yul gyi// 'od kyis rang gzhan sgrib gnyis sbyangs// 'phags ma'i go 'phang bkod par bsam// slar yang mos gus shugs drag pos// bla ma mchog gsum rin po cher// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// mkhyen brtse nus ldan khyed rnams kyis// bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ces pas gsol btab skyabs yul rnams// mtha' nas rim gyis 'od zhu nas// rtsa ba'i bla mar thim pa nyid// bdag thim byin gyis brlabs par bsam// gnyis pa smon 'jug sems bskyed ni// bdag gis sems can kun don phyir// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya// de yi ched du rje btsun ma'i// sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi// lan gsum gsum pa tshogs bsag la// dang po bsod nams tshogs bsag slad// rang nyid 'phags ma'i skur gsal ba'i// thugs ka'i zla steng tām̐ yig las// 'od 'phros bla ma rje btsun ma// mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs gyur// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ

na ma ār+ya tā rā+e sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ oṃ gu ru ār+ya tā rā+e sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da ā hūm̐/ zhes pa'i phyag mchod sngon 'gro bas// sdig bshags rjes su yi rang dang*// don dam sems bskyed skyabs su 'gro// smon 'jug sdom bzung bsngo ba bcas// yan lag bdun pa bya ba ni// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum tshad med bsgom pa ni// 'gro kun bde ba rgyur bcas ldan// sdug bsngal rgyur bcas bral bar shog /rtag tu bde dang mi 'bral zhing*// btang snyoms chen por gnas gyur cig /de nas ye shes tshogs bsag phyir// oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas gzung 'dzin chos rnams kun// 'od gsal dbyings su thim par bsam// gnyis pa dngos gzhir thung mong dang*// khyad par dmigs rim rnam gnyis las// dang po yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyis// lhar bsgom gsal snang bsgrub pa ni// stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ yig las// byung ba'i pad dkar 'dab brgyad steng*// a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus// rang sems tām̐ yig dkar po las// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro don byas// tshur 'dus yongs gyur skad cig gis// rang nyid sgrol ma dkar mo ni// yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe sbyin ma// ston ka'i zla ba'i mdangs 'dra zhing*// nor bu chu shel dri med 'od// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma// phyag zhabs mthil na spyan re ste// ye shes spyan 'dun 'dzum pas gzigs// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgya mdzad// g.yon pas ut+pal dkar po yi// rtsa ba thugs kar bzung ba nyid// me tog snyan thad kha bye ba'i// g.yas g.yon 'bras bu gong bus dud// dbu skra mthon mthing ltar gnag pa'i// zur phud ltag par bcings pa las// lan bu ring du 'phyangs bas mdzes// rin po che yi rgyan brgyad dang*// sna tshogs dar gyis stod g.yogs shing*// dmar po'i sham thabs mdzes par gsol// zla ba'i rgyab yol la brten nas// zhabs gnyis skyil krung drang por bzhugs// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis// rang bzhin gnas nas sgrol ma dkar// sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor dang bcas// oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis med thim// slar yang dbang lha spyan drangs nas// bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas// sku gang sgrib dag rigs kyi bdag /'od dpag med pas dbur brgyan gyur// rang gi thugs las sprul pa yi// lha mos mchod cing bstod par bsam// oṃ ār+yā tā rā+e sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tut+tā ra yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res na ba rnams las sgrol// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs ji ltar rigs pas bstod// nga rgyal rnam pa'i gsal snang la// sems bzung bsam gtan dug dbyung zhing*// 'dzin med lta bas rgyas 'debs bya// gnyis pa khyad par dmigs rim la// dang po 'khor lo gsal ba ni// thugs kar zla ba'i rang bzhin gyi// 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa// mu khyud lnga ldan lte bar tām̐// mtha' skor spel tshig mdun rgyab tu// oṃ dang hā ste rtsibs brgyad la// tā re la sogs yig 'bru brgyad// mu khyud dang por ā li g.yon// gnyis par kā li gsum pa na// rten 'brel snying po g.yas su 'khod// bzhi par rdo rje sngon po dang*// lnga par 'od lnga'i phreng bas bskor// gnyis pa rigs bdag 'pho ba ni// spyi bo'i rigs bdag yongs gyur las// tshe dpag med mgon dkar dmar mdangs// phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin// longs sku'i chas rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs// gsum pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni// rang gi phyi rol 'khor lo dkar// rtsibs brgyad g.yas su 'khor ba las// me dpung 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa yis// gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad bsregs// thugs ka'i tām̐ yig sngags bcas las// 'od zer dkar po zla ba stong*// dus gcig shar ba lta bu 'phros// lus gang nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs// ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros pas// 'khor lo'i phyi rol 'dom gang sar// 'od zer dkar po'i gur gyis gtams// zhi ba'i las kun 'grub par gyur// de bzhin 'od zer gser mdog 'phros// lus gang tshe bsod ye shes spel// phyir 'phros ser po'i gur gyis gtams// rgyas pa'i las kun 'grub par gyur// pad rāka mdangs can 'od zer 'phros// lus gang khams gsum dbang du bsdus// phyir 'phros dmar po'i gur gyis gtams// dbang gi las kun 'grub par gyur// dbang sngon mdangs can 'od zer 'phros// lus gang mi mthun tshar bcad cing*// phyir 'phros sngon po'i gur gyis gtams// drag po'i las kun 'grub par gyur// margad mdangs can 'od zer 'phros// lus gang phrin las thams cad bsgrubs// phyir 'phros 'od ljang gur gyis gtams// mchog thun phrin las kun 'grub gyur// 'od zer mchin kha dpag med 'phros// lus gang phrin las brtan par byas// phyir 'phros mchin kha'i gur gyis gtams// byin rlabs phrin las brtan par gyur// 'od kyi gur khang drug po kun// sgo nga'i rnam pa ji lta bar// dum bu gcig tu gyur pa yi// bar mtshams ut+pal sngon po ni// gsar zhing mnyen lcug ldan pas gtams// mi phyed rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyur// bzhi pa tshe bcud bsdu ba ni// rig bdag thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las// 'od 'phros srid zhi'i tshe bcud kun// bum par bsdus thim bdud rtsir zhu// rang lus kun khyab 'chi med thob// bum can rlung gi sbyor ba ni// ji ltar rigs pas brtan par bya// lnga pa bzlas pa bya ba ni// slar yang thugs ka'i 'khor lo las// bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang 'od zer dkar// sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs par 'phros// lus gang nad gdon sdig sgrib dang*// dus min 'chi ba rgyur bcas sbyangs// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob// ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad kyang*// bdud rtsi'i zil pa phrom mer gyur// oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā// rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa 'bru bcu pa// gtso bor bzlas shing thun gyi gsham// oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma ā yur puṇ+ye dzñā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes pa'ang ji ltar rigs pa bzlas// gsum pa rjes ni mchod bstod dang*// bcom ldan yid bzhin 'khor lo yis// bdag dang mtha' yas 'gro ba kun// mi mthun 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*// 'chi med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pas dngos grub gsol ba gdab// dbyangs gsal rten snying yig brgya rnams// lan gsum bzlas pas gsang sngags kyi// nus pa brtan cing lhag chad bskang*// snod bcud 'od zhu srung 'khor dang*// de yang rang thim 'od gsal dang*// slar yang 'phags ma'i skur gyur pa'i// gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs bsngo smon shis brjod bcas// thun mtshams spyod lam rim par 'jug /de ltar thun bzhi'i rim pa yis// zla ba drug tu rtse gcig bsgoms// 'jigs pa mtha' dag zhi ba dang*// lhag par dus min 'chi ba bzlog /'chi med go 'phang nges 'grub cing*// gzhan yang tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas// blo rno shes rab dri med 'gyur// mdor na grub pa brgyad dang ni// phrin las bzhi sogs ci 'dod kun// tshul 'dir 'bad pa las 'byung phyir// skal bzang rnams kyis bsten par 'os// zhes 'di rdo rje'i slob dpon che// dzā na bha dra'i bkas bskul zhing*// gzhan la'ang phan par 'dod pa yis// yid kyi bdud rtsi'i chu gter las// bsrubs skyes zla shel gsar pa ste// legs byas 'od dkar lhung ba yis// srid zhi'i mun pa kun bcil zhing*// phan bde'i kun+da bzhad gyur cig/ ༈ /swa sti/ gang zhig gnas skabs su mtho ris kyi yon tan mtha' dag gi phyi mo/ dri ma med pa'i bslab pa gsum gyi snod/ thun mong gi dngos grub kyis phan 'dogs pa'i gzhi/ mthar thug mchog gi dngos grub kyang rten 'di kho na la rag las pa'i phyir/

spyir 'dzam bu gling pa khams drug ldan gyi lus/ bye brag tu dal 'byor gyi rten/ khyad par chos bzhin spyod pa/ de las kyang sngags kyi dngos grub mchog don du gnyer ba rnams kyi 'tsho ba ni shin tu don dang bcas pa'i phyir yun ring por gnas pa'i thabs tshul lhur len pa kho na gal che/ de la'ang 'jig rten na lha dang drang srong chen po rnams kyis ring 'tsho'i thabs tshul du ma zhig gsungs kyang*/ de thams cad kyis phyag byas pa'i drang srong mchog gcig pu ston pa bde bar gshegs pas mdo dang*/ sngags kyi tshul las/ tshul khrims kyi kun spyod dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dang*/ shes rab zab mo'i rgyas 'debs dang*/ sngags dang*/ sman dang*/ nor bu dang*/ rten 'brel dang*/ nang 'ba' zhig la gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor zab pa dang*/ ches zab pa'i sgo nas tshe bsring ba dang*/ bar chad sel ba dang*/ 'chi med ye shes kyi sku sgrub pa'i thabs tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yid can rnams la thugs brtse ba kho nas bka' stsal pa nyid gtso bor bzung bar rigs te/ 'khrul pa'i rgyu spangs pa dang*/ ma 'khrul pa'i ye shes brnyes pa dang*/ snying brtse'i thabs yun ring du goms pa'i mthu las byung ba'i phyir ro// de lta bas na legs par gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos rnams kyi snying por gyur pa'ang rdo rje theg pa nyid yin la/ de nyid thun mong gi tshul las ches zab pa'i phyir dbang po rnon po rnams kyis gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde rin po che las gsungs pa'i ring 'tsho'i sgo du ma la nan tan du bya rigs pas/ 'dir rnal 'byor bla med ma yi rgyud sgrol ma mngon par 'byung ba las/ 'chi ba slu byed dkar mo'o// nad dang btson las thar pa dang*// tshe dang longs spyod brtson 'grus dang*// dbang phyug dang ni blo gros 'phel// ces gsungs pas bstan par bzhad cing*/ lha dang*/ sngags kyi dbang gis bya rgyud pad+ma'i rigs kyi yum du bzhag kyang mi 'gal ba rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i skor la 'phags bod du bka' srol mi 'dra ba du ma zhig byung ba las gtso bor gyur pa ni/

'phags ma nyid kyi ye shes sras mngon sum du dbugs dbyung ba thob pa'i slob dpon chen po ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa'i gzhung*/ 'chi bdag bslu ba'i rtog pa bsdus pa las 'byung ba nyid deng sang gi bar du bka' yod la/ lhad ma zhugs par gnas pa yin pas de gtso bor byas te bshad na/ nges shes 'dren byed lo rgyus dang*/ de las byung ba'i gdams pa dngos gnyis/ phyi ma la'ang*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i snod rung du bya ba rjes gnang dang*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs lam gyi rim pa gnyis/ phyi ma la/ sngon du bsnyen pas lha mnyes par bya ba dang*/ bar du sgrub pas bdag nyid nus ldan du bya ba dang*/ mthar nus pa dang ldan pa des las rab 'byams sgrub pa'i tshul te gsum las/ de yang spyir tshul 'di'i sgom bzlas kyi rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa la bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi dmigs pa'i gnad thams cad 'dril bas dbang po rab 'bring rnams kyis de kho nas don 'grub pa'i phyir las sbyor sogs dmigs bsal ma bgyis kyang rung mod/ dbang po rtul po dang*/ dang po'i las can dang*/ spros pa la dga' ba sogs kyi ched du thabs tshul sna tshogs kyang mi 'gog pa'i phyir rim par bshad na/ lo rgyus yig rnying dang rjes gnang kho bos logs su bkod pa las gsal/ bsnyen pa'i tshul thun mong ltar na ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sgrub thabs dang*/ zhu chen paṇ+ḍi ta tshul khrims rin chen gyi bsnyen yig dang*/ khyad par 'od zer drug bsgrags ltar na/ tshar chen rin po che'i yig cha 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyis nag 'gros su mdzad pa dang*/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang legs grub kyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen yig ltar bya'o// sbyin sreg kyang zhi rgyas rnam pa gnyis kyi yig cha gzhan dag tu ches gsal ba'i phyir de rnams su shes par bya zhing*/ de las gzhan pa'i las sbyor la/

tshe bsring ba gtso bor bton pa dang*/ las sna tshogs pa bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po la'ang*/ spyir 'chi bdag bslu ba'i rtog pa nas ji skad gsungs pa phal cher 'dir sbyor 'os shing*/ de la rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab kyang nye bar bsdu na/ ji skad du/ phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid kyi// 'chi ltas tshogs pa shes byas nas// phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid kyi// bslu ba bsdus pa'ang shes par bya// zhes dang*/ lus dang ngag gi las kyis phyi// bsam gtan las kyis nang gi yin// nor bu sman sogs phyi yin te// rnal 'byor nus pa nang gi'o// zhes phyi dang*/ nang gi 'chi ba bslu ba'i thabs mang du gsungs shing*/ de dag la'ang rnam grangs mang du mchis kyang*/ 'dir nang bsgom pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ phyi bris pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ bcud len gyi ril bu la brten nas tshe yi bar chad zhi zhing dngos grub thob pa'i thabs gsum las/ dang po ni/ khrid yig rnams dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ yig rnying gi gzhung du gsal bas/ gsum pa nyid 'dir cung zad bshad na/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ bden par smra zhing khro ba med// dbang po bsdams shing bdag nyid thul// zhi zhing dam pa'i spyod la dga'// rtag tu bcud len yin zhes bya// yon tan 'di dag ldan gyur pas// gang zhig bcud len bsten gyur pa// de ni dga' zhing tshe ring la// 'jig rten 'di dang gzhan du bde// zhes dang*/ slob dpon ngag dbang grags pas/ sman rnams kyi ni mthu la yang*// som nyi bya bar rigs min te// gang phyir sman rnams nus pa ni// bsam mi khyab par kun tu snang*// zhes pas mtshon ring por 'tsho ba'i thabs kyi mchog gcig tu bsngags shing*/ zhes dang*/ lha dang drang srong gis bshad pa dang*/ ston pa bde bar gshegs pas sngags rgyud rab 'byams las rgya cher bka' stsal na'ang*/ dngul chu sogs rdzas kyi sbyor ba ches dka' zhing*/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sogs sbyor pa 'ga' zhig brtul zhugs grub pa rnams kyi dbang du mdzad pas ni/

'dir thun mong gis bsten du rung ba nyid brjod par skabs su babs la/ de la'ang rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab kyang*/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ 'bras bu gsum ni spyir bsdus pa'am// so so bhṛṅga rā dza bcas// rnal 'byor pa yis rtag spyad na// phan zhing bdud rtsir 'gyur ba yis// gnyer ma skra dkar rnams dang bral// rdo rje yi ni gzugs bzang ldan// bskal pa yi ni grangs snyed du// 'chi ba nges par bzlog pa yin// zhes gsungs pa nyid bsgrub sla zhing khungs che ba dang*/ skabs 'dir nges par 'brel chags pa'i phyir bshad na/ spyir 'di la 'gyur tha dad pa'i dbang gis tshig ris cung mi mthun pa dag snang mod/ sngar gzhung 'di nyid kyi bshad srol ma nyams pa'i skabs kyi yig rnying mchan dang bcas pa zhig mthong bas de bzhin du dbye na/ sman sbyar ba dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ bsten tshul phan yon dang bcas pa'o// dang po ni/ 'bras bu gsum zhes pa/ a ru/ skyu ru/ ba ru gsum yin zhing*/ de'i nus pa'ang ji skad du/ 'bras bu gsum po rtag bsten na// tshe ring nad rnams zhi ba dang*// dbang po gsal zhing stobs ldan pas// bcud kyi len gyi mchog tu bshad// ces dang*/ bye brag tu/ slob dpon klus sbyor ba brgya pa'i mchog gi sbyor ba las/ bcud len kun la skyu ru ra zhes bshad/ bhṛ gaṃ rā dza ni rje btsun grags pa'i gsung rab las/ ra mo shag yin par gsungs shing*/ nus pa'ang*/ ra mnyes pho ba'i me drod skyed// rnag skem lus po yang rtsal che// yi ga 'byed cing bad mkhris sel// bcud len pa yi mchog tu 'gyur// zhes pas mtshon/ bcud len thams cad kyi rgyal por bsngags/ de rnams kyi ngos 'dzin yang*/ a ru ra la rigs lnga las/ 'dir bdud rtsi sha ma thug ces/ mdog ser zhing sha che la ma thug pa nyid bsngags shing*/ skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu sha rus phral nas skam pa dang*/

ba ru ra kha dog gsal zhing mkhregs pa/ ra mnye ni lo ma nag mthug ral gri 'dra ba/ sdong po smug po/ me tog dmar zhing*/ rtsa ba dkar la ser mdangs can sob pa de yin la/ de'ang sa gtsang zhing mkhregs sar skyes pa ston dus rtsi ma skam pa'i dus su rtsa ba ma nyams par brkos nas grib mar skam/ sbyor tshad/ a ru ra gtso bor byas te/ de yi phyed skyu ru ra/ de phyed ba ru ra/ skyu ru ra dang mnyam pa'i ra mnye rnams gtsang zhing lhad dang bral ba sta gon du bya/ ji ltar sbyar tshul ni/ 'bras bu gsum spyir bsdus pa'am/ yang na so so ste re re dang*/ ra mo shag sbyar bar gsungs na'ang*/ bzhi ga sbyar ba nyid legs/ ra mnye la gzhan du bcud 'gugs pa'i thabs sogs bshad kyang 'dir dmigs kyis ma bsal bas ma byas kyang rung*/ gang ltar yang tshad bzhin 'du byas pa'i sman rnams zhib par btags/ bcud len gyi sman rnams rten 'brel gyi khyad par las/ gtso bo sngon la mi brdung par gsungs pas a ru ra rjes su brdung par bshad/ de la 'phrad mngar gsum/ dam rtsi dbang lag bum sgrub byed na bum rdzas nyer lnga phran bu dang bcas te/ dam pa snga ma rnams kyis tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i ril bu yod na'ang sbyar zhing ril bu che chung sran 'phos tsam du dril/ grib mar skam zhing ril chags 'them par bya'o// gzhan yang rtsa ba'i sman ni sngar bshad pa kho na yin la/ yan lag tu/ gso dpyad kyi gzhung las 'byung ba'i/ rtsa ba lnga zhes ra mnye/ nye shing*/ lca ba/ ba spu/ gze ma rnams las phyi ma bzhi dang*/ dwangs ma lnga zhes cong zhi/ brag zhun/ mar/ sbrang*/ bu ram rnams dang*/ rtsi bzhi zhes/ shug 'brum/ ba lu/ mkhan dkar/ mtshe rnams dang*/ bcud len spyi la bsngags pa dbang po lag pa sogs kyang ji ltar rags pa gtong du rung mod/ sman gyi rnam grangs khungs ldan rnyed dka' zhing*/ dam pa 'ga' zhig gis sman sna mang bas nus pa 'phrog par yang gsungs phyir sngar bshad pa tsam gyis kyang don 'grub bo// gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa'i tshul ni/

rtsa bar sgrub tshul dmigs su ma gsal zhing*/ bcud len gyi rigs gzhan la'ang 'ga' zhig ma gtogs sgrub dgos par bshad kyang*/ rnal 'byor pa yis zhes pas/ 'di bstan pa'ang gtso bor lha yi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bsten par bshad la/ des na ril bu'ang lha dang sngags kyi nus pas byin gyis brlab pa la 'gal ba med pa dang*/ snga phyi'i dam pa 'ga' zhig kyang*/ gzhan don du sgrol dkar gyi bum sgrub byed skabs/ yun ring na bum chu rul ba sogs kyi skyon 'byung bas/ tshe rdzas dang sbyar ba'i ril bu sgrub pa nyid legs par bshad pas de ltar lag tu blang ba'i tshul ni/ ma ti/ pañtsa/ gnas gtsang zhing yid dang mthun par stegs bu'i dbus pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi khar bum pa

bum pa'i nang du ril bu blug khar yang*/ khrus sngon du 'gro bar bya/ stong chen rab 'byams las gsungs pa'i sman bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'ang bya/ mchan/ ril bu'i bcud kyis sum gnyis gang ba kha rgyan gzungs rdor dang bcas pa'i mthar gtor ma dang*/ mchod pas bskor/ bsnyen pa las su rung ba'i rnal 'byor pas khrus dang gtsang sbra'i kun spyod la gnas pas/ brgyud 'debs nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa nyer bsdu'i bar dang*/ mdun bskyed bum pa sgrub pa/ gtor ma 'bul ba/ rjes chog sogs thams cad sgrub mchod kyi cho ga dkyus nas 'byung ba ji lta ba bzhin la/ bum bskyed skabs/ nang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba/ zhes dang*/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa bcud la thim pas 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ces pa tsam gyi khyad par ro// de ltar thun bzhi'i rim pas zhag grangs ji ltar rigs pa bsgrubs shing*/ thun so so'i mthar mchod bstod nongs bshags bsngo smon shis brjod bcas dang*/ thun phyi ma rnams kyi mgor sngar yod gsal 'debs kyi tshul du lhar bskyed cing bzlas pa bya/ grol rgyu'i thun tha ma la/ mchod bstod nongs bshags kyi mthar/ mchod yon phul ba'i tshul dang bcas/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod pas/ bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu nas bcud la thim pas 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi dngos grub mtha' dag stsol ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces dang*/ slar yang brtan bzhugs dang*/ shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gi phreng bas mtha' brgyan/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i ril bu de nyid rlung mi 'chor ba'i snod bzang por gtsang sbra dang bcas pas 'chang zhing longs spyad par bya'o// gang dag rdzas rnams mang du ma rnyed kyang*/ ci tsam 'byor pa'i phab gta' dang 'bras dkar gyi phye ma mngar gsum sogs dang sbyar nas ril bur bgyis te ji skad bshad pa'i cho gas bsgrubs na/ rten 'brel dang*/

sngags kyi nus pa gnyis tshogs pa'i phyir phan yon ci rigs pa 'byung bar nges pa'ang zhar las 'phros pa'i don to// gsum pa rjes bsten tshul phan yon dang bcas pa ni/ gtso bor sgrol ma dkar mo sogs lhag pa'i lha yi rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa po'am/ dam tshig dang ldan pa gzhan gyis kyang rung ste/ yar ngo'i tshes gcig lta bu gza' skar sbyor byed shis pa'i tho rangs nas mgo brtsams te ril bu gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun la sogs pa rtag tu bsten pa'am ji tsam nus pa spyad na/ rnam par gyur pa'i nad thams cad la phan zhing*/ rnam par ma gyur pa'i lus zungs kyi dwangs ma bdud rtsir 'gyur ba dang*/ de yi nus pas gnyer ma dang*/ skra dkar la sogs pa rgas pa'i rtags rnams dang bral zhing*/ kha dog gsal ba dang*/ yid gzhungs pa dang*/ ring por 'tsho bas na rdo rje ltar mi phyed pa'i gzugs bzang po dang ldan par 'gyur zhing*/ yun ring du bsten na lhag pa'i lha yi byin rlabs dang*/ sngags kyi mthu dang*/ sman gyi nus pa la brten nas bskal pa'am/ bskal pa las lhag par 'chi ba nges par bzlog cing*/ tshe la dbang ba'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i gzugs su 'gyur la/ de lta bu'i rten de la brten nas lam gyi lhag ma rnams bgrod de myur du byang chub mchog gi go 'phang thob par 'gyur pa ni nges pa'o// ༈ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgo nas ngag gi byad 'grol ba'i man ngag phan bde'i zla snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru tā rā yai/ 'dir rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgo nas ngag gi byad srung ba dang 'grol bar 'dod pas/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// sogs lan gsum gyis skyabs sems bya/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun sgrol mar gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/

rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma bla ma 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas tshogs zhing spyan drang*/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ gyis gdan 'bul/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma ār+ya tā rā sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag byas/ oṃ gu ru ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ gis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ bcom ldan 'das ma tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor los bdag gi ngag bcings pa dang mnan pa las grol bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rang gi snying gar me'i rang bzhin ram̐ yig dmar po/ mgrin par nag po/ lce rtser tam̐ nag po rnams kyis mtshan pa/ mdun gyi rje btsun ma'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi snying ga'i ram̐ la phog pas de las me dmar lam gyis 'bar bas mgrin pa dang lce rtse'i yi ge nag po gnyis gzhob thul gyis tshig par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hwā saṃ rak+ṣa si hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas mthar/ mdun gyi rje btsun ma 'khor bcas rang la thim zhing*/ rang gi lce rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od 'bar ba nas mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ tā re tā re ye bha ga wa ti dzi hwā bā ka ban+dha mo tsa swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa oṃ rdo rje'i lce yang dag par srungs shig hūm̐/ brgyad bzla'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// sogs dang*/ gzhan yang skye ba 'di nyid du// sogs kyis dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab/ bgegs rigs oṃ sgrol ma sgrol ma gang gi ched du bcom ldan 'das mas lce dang ngag 'ching bgrol ba'i gzhi tshugs/ stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*// sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// de ltar rgyun du tho rangs snga bar nyams su blangs pas ngag bcings pa dang mnan pa sogs kyi skyon las grol ba myong bas grub cing*/

'di la bdag mdun gnyis kar yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyis lhar bskyed pa dang*/ mchod bstod rgyas par bya bar bshad pa bzhin spro na byas kyang rung mod/ rgyun du 'di kho nas don 'grub pa nyid do// zhes pa'ang dpal stag lung mchog sprul rin po che'i nyams gzhes su bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos yig rnying gi dgongs don ltar sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun ngag gi nyes skyon thams cad las grol nas/ gsung rdo rje rnam pa thams cad pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
